Download pypi artifacts

Download a wheel or a source distribution from a PyPI repository. rp reads the
simple index of the project (GET &lt;repo&gt;/simple/&lt;package&gt;/, the page pip reads),
picks the version (--version, default the highest release, else the highest
pre-release, as pip does; a yanked file is never picked unless --version names
it), picks one file of that version, and downloads it from the link of the
index. The link carries the SHA-256 of the file, and the download is verified
against it (a file whose link has no usable digest is stored and reported as
not verified).

The package name may be written in any spelling (My_Package.Name,
my-package-name): rp asks for the PEP 503 normalized name, which is what the
server stores.

A version usually has several files. rp chooses by itself only when the choice
is clear (one file, or one pure Python wheel); otherwise it lists the files and
stops, and you pick one with --file &lt;name&gt;, or narrow it down with --type wheel
or --type sdist. rp does not match wheels to a platform.

```
rp download pypi <package> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --dir string       Directory to store the file in (created when missing) (default ".")
      --file string      Exact file name to download (for example demo-1.0.0-py3-none-any.whl)
      --force            Replace the file when it already exists
      --repo string      Repository to download from (required)
      --type string      Choose among wheels or source distributions only: wheel or sdist
      --version string   Version to download (default: the newest the format knows)
```
